comment: Directory imports that must not exist. Read by `npm run layers -- --check` (scripts/check-layers.mjs). `from` and `to` are regular expressions over directory units as the report prints them (e.g. `ui/reader`, `types`; the root unit must be written `\(root\)`, since parentheses are regex groups). `typesAllowed: true` lets type-only imports through. A rule is added in the restructure step that makes it true — see docs/refactor/RESTRUCTURE.md §2 and the phase plans.

forbidden.why: lib imports only types (layer 0; Phase 1 step 1a)
platform imports only lib and types (layer 1; Phase 1 step 1b)
services imports only lib and types (layer 1; Phase 1 step 1e)
domain code imports neither the composition root nor the UI, shared components included (layer 2; Phase 1 steps 1e, 1f, 1n)
top-level ui (screens, shared hooks) does not reach into a screen's folder (Phase 1 step 1g)
the translation core does not know its providers; the registry lives with them (Phase 1 step 1h)
the composition root does not import the UI, shared components included (layer 3 below layer 4; Phase 1 step 1n)
shared components import only lib and types (Phase 1 step 1n)
nothing outside the root imports main.tsx or App.tsx (Phase 1 step 1n)
